description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseModuleActivator' within the org.openmrs.module package. The class provides default (empty) implementations for the methods declared in the ModuleActivator interface, allowing subclasses (modules) to respond to application lifecycle events such as start, stop, refresh, etc.

classes.name: BaseModuleActivator
classes.description: An abstract class that implements the ModuleActivator interface, providing empty method implementations for lifecycle hooks used by modules in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: contextRefreshed
methods.description: Method called when the application context is refreshed. Default implementation is empty.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Method called when the module is started. Default implementation is empty.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Method called when the module is stopped. Default implementation is empty.

methods.name: willRefreshContext
methods.description: Method called before the context is refreshed. Default implementation is empty.

methods.name: willStart
methods.description: Method called before the module starts. Default implementation is empty.

methods.name: willStop
methods.description: Method called before the module stops. Default implementation is empty.
